description: This file defines a ref struct called ExecutionContextSuppressor that manages the suppression of ExecutionContext flow within a scope, to control context propagation in asynchronous programming. It provides a constructor and a Dispose method to suppress and restore flow, respectively.

classes.name: ExecutionContextSuppressor
classes.description: A ref struct that temporarily suppresses the flow of ExecutionContext for its scope, ensuring context does not flow across asynchronous continuations.

methods.name: ExecutionContextSuppressor
methods.description: Constructor that suppresses the ExecutionContext flow if it is not already suppressed, storing the state to restore later.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Restores the ExecutionContext flow if it was suppressed by this instance.
